baselines.description: A scripted policy on the same worlds: inspect the best uninspected open listing when the inspection pays for itself in expectation, offer the ask plus one on the best listing it has verified sound, sign only verified-sound holds. A yardstick, not an optimum: a route can beat it on a part, as good blind bets do.
baselines.label: scripted inspect-then-sign reference

replay_check.statement: the replayed policy reproduces every published reference payoff

classes.amount_basis: p x (lemon loss - (value if sound - rent)) - fee: what inspecting first would have saved in expectation

walked from or let expire a hold worth more than its rent in expectation
signed at a rent above the posted ask

classes.amount_basis: value lost to the draw: expected value minus true value
